name: @voteship/mcp-server

tools.name: submit_feature_request
tools.description: Use this when the user wants to send new product feedback to a public VoteShip board without administering the project. Submit a feature request to any public VoteShip board. No API key needed. The post is created as PENDING and requires board owner approval. Include metadata.source to identify your agent.

project_slug.description: Project slug (e.g. 'my-app'). Optional if VOTESHIP_PROJECT_SLUG env var is set.

description.description: Detailed description of the feature request

source.description: Name of the agent or app submitting this request (stored in metadata.source)

tools.name: browse_board
tools.description: Use this when the user wants to inspect, compare, or interact with approved requests on a public VoteShip board. View approved feature requests on a public VoteShip board. No API key needed. Returns posts sorted by vote count and renders an interactive board in MCP Apps clients.

project_slug.description: Project slug (e.g. 'my-app'). Optional if VOTESHIP_PROJECT_SLUG env var is set.

tools.name: upvote_post
tools.description: Use this when the user explicitly wants to add or remove their agent identity's vote on a known VoteShip post. Vote or unvote on a feature request (toggles). Uses a deterministic anonymous ID so the same agent on the same machine has a consistent identity. No API key needed.

post_id.description: The post ID to vote on

tools.name: add_public_comment
tools.description: Use this when the user wants to add public context or a follow-up to a known VoteShip feature request. Add a comment to a feature request on a public VoteShip board. No API key needed. Requires an author name.

post_id.description: The post ID to comment on

author_name.description: Display name for the comment author

tools.name: list_posts
tools.description: Use this when the user wants to review, filter, rank, or select feature requests in their VoteShip project. List feature requests with optional filters for status, sorting, and pagination

status.description: Filter by status: PENDING, APPROVED, IN_PROGRESS, COMPLETE, CLOSED, ARCHIVED

tools.name: get_post
tools.description: Use this when the user needs the full details, votes, comments, or tags for a specific VoteShip post. Get a single feature request post with its votes, comments, and tags

tools.name: create_post
tools.description: Use this when the user wants to add a structured feature request directly to the project they administer. Create a new feature request post. Title is required. Status defaults to PENDING if not provided.

description.description: Detailed description of the feature request

status.description: Initial status: PENDING, APPROVED, IN_PROGRESS, COMPLETE, CLOSED, ARCHIVED

tools.name: update_post
tools.description: Use this when the user wants to change a known request's title, description, workflow status, or tags. Update an existing post's title, description, status, or tags. Only include fields you want to change.

status.description: New status: PENDING, APPROVED, IN_PROGRESS, COMPLETE, CLOSED, ARCHIVED

tag_ids.description: Comma-separated tag IDs (replaces all existing tags)

tools.name: delete_post
tools.description: Use this when the user has explicitly confirmed permanent deletion of a known feature request and its related votes and comments. Permanently delete a feature request and all its associated votes and comments

tools.name: unarchive_post
tools.description: Use this when the user wants to undo shipping a specific archived request and return it to completed work. Restore an archived post back to COMPLETE status and unlink it from its release. Use this to undo a ship operation for a specific post.

post_id.description: The ARCHIVED post ID to restore

tools.name: search_similar
tools.description: Use this when the user or agent needs to check for duplicate or related feedback before creating or consolidating a request. Find similar feature requests using AI semantic search (pgvector). Useful for checking if a request already exists before creating a new one.

query.description: Natural language search query, e.g. 'export data as PDF'

tools.name: add_vote
tools.description: Use this when the project administrator wants to record a vote for a known board user or anonymous identity. Add a vote to a feature request. You must provide either a board_user_id or anonymous_id to identify the voter.

post_id.description: The post ID to vote on

anonymous_id.description: Anonymous ID (for unidentified users, e.g. a fingerprint or UUID)

tools.name: get_voters
tools.description: Use this when the user wants to see who voted for a specific feature request. List all users who voted on a specific feature request

post_id.description: The post ID to get voters for

tools.name: add_comment
tools.description: Use this when the user wants to add a public comment or internal note to a known feature request. Add a comment or internal note to a feature request post

post_id.description: The post ID to comment on

author_name.description: Display name for the comment author

is_internal_note.description: If true, creates an internal note visible only to team members (default: false)

tools.name: get_comments
tools.description: Use this when the user wants to review discussion or internal notes attached to a specific request. List comments on a feature request post. By default returns only public comments.

post_id.description: The post ID to get comments for

internal.description: Filter: 'true' for only internal notes, 'all' for both public and internal. Omit for public only.

tools.name: delete_comment
tools.description: Use this when the user has explicitly confirmed deletion of a specific comment from a feature request. Delete a comment from a feature request post. Only works for comments on posts in your project.

post_id.description: The post ID the comment belongs to

tools.name: list_tags
tools.description: Use this when the user or agent needs valid project tags before categorizing, filtering, or creating feedback. List all available tags for categorizing feature requests

tools.name: create_tag
tools.description: Use this when the user wants a new reusable category for feature requests in their project. Create a new tag for categorizing feature requests

theme.description: Hex color for the tag, e.g. '#6366f1'

tools.name: list_users
tools.description: Use this when the user wants to inspect customers who submitted feedback or voted, including their revenue context. List board users who have submitted feedback or voted on feature requests

tools.name: update_user
tools.description: Use this when the user wants to correct a board user's identity details or customer-spend value. Update a board user's spend/revenue value, name, or email

user_id.description: The board user ID to update

tools.name: get_roadmap
tools.description: Use this when the user wants to review planned, in-progress, and completed requests grouped as a roadmap. Get the product roadmap — feature requests grouped by status (Approved, In Progress, Complete), sorted by vote count

tools.name: list_releases
tools.description: Use this when the user wants to review previously published product updates or select a release. List published changelog releases

tools.name: create_release
tools.description: Use this when the user wants to draft or publish a new changelog entry without automatically archiving completed posts. Create a new changelog release. Saved as a draft by default unless is_draft is explicitly set to false.

is_draft.description: Save as draft (true, default) or publish immediately (false)

tools.name: get_release
tools.description: Use this when the user needs the complete contents and state of a specific changelog release. Get a single changelog release by ID

tools.name: update_release
tools.description: Use this when the user wants to revise a known release or change whether it is a draft. Update a changelog release's title, content, or draft status. Only include fields you want to change.

is_draft.description: Set to true for draft, false to publish

tools.name: delete_release
tools.description: Use this when the user has explicitly confirmed permanent deletion of a specific changelog release. Permanently delete a changelog release. Posts linked to this release will be unlinked but not deleted.

tools.name: ship_release
tools.description: Use this when the user explicitly wants to publish a release, link completed requests, and archive those requests in one operation. Ship a release: create a published changelog entry, link the specified posts, and archive them. This is the one-click ship flow.

post_ids.description: IDs of COMPLETE posts to include in the release and archive

tools.name: get_analytics
tools.description: Use this when the user wants quantitative feedback, voting, traffic, or trend metrics for a time period. Get analytics summary — new posts, votes, comments, page views, top posts, and trending tags for a given time period

period.description: Time period: week, month, or quarter (default: week)

tools.name: sync_stripe_revenue
tools.description: Use this when the user explicitly wants to refresh VoteShip board-user revenue from their connected Stripe account. Sync customer MRR from connected Stripe account to board users. Requires Growth plan.

tools.name: submit_feedback
tools.description: Use this when the user wants VoteShip to extract, deduplicate, and categorize a feature request from a message, email, ticket, or transcript. Submit unstructured text as a feature request. AI extracts the title, description, checks for duplicates, and auto-categorizes with tags. Great for processing Slack messages, emails, or support tickets.

text.description: Raw text describing a feature request, e.g. 'Multiple customers asked for PDF export'

source.description: Where the feedback came from: slack, email, support, intercom, etc.

source_url.description: URL to the original message (e.g. Slack permalink)

tools.name: triage_inbox
tools.description: Use this when the user wants AI recommendations for pending feedback, duplicates, tags, priority, and next actions without applying changes. AI-powered triage of unreviewed feature requests. Analyzes pending posts, detects duplicates, suggests status/tags, and provides priority recommendations. Requires Growth plan.

tools.name: get_summary
tools.description: Use this when the user wants an AI-generated briefing on recent feedback themes, highlights, and recommended actions. Generate an AI-powered natural language summary of recent feedback trends, highlights, and recommended actions. Requires Growth plan.

period.description: Time period: week, month, or quarter (default: week)

tools.name: plan_sprint
tools.description: Use this when the user wants a read-only sprint recommendation based on approved requests, votes, tags, and a prioritization strategy. AI-suggested sprint plan based on approved feature requests, votes, tags, and the selected prioritization strategy. Requires Growth plan.

capacity.description: Number of features to include in the sprint (default: 5, max: 20)

strategy.description: Prioritization strategy: balanced, revenue, popular, or quick-wins (default: balanced)

tools.name: configure_webhook
tools.description: Use this when the user explicitly wants VoteShip events delivered to an external HTTPS endpoint. Create a new webhook endpoint to receive real-time notifications. Events: post.created, post.updated, post.deleted, post.status_changed, vote.created, vote.removed, comment.created, comment.deleted, tag.created, tag.deleted, release.published, or * for all.

url.description: The HTTPS URL to receive webhook POST requests

events.description: Comma-separated event types to subscribe to, e.g. 'post.created,vote.created' or '*' for all

instructions: Use VoteShip when the user wants to collect or submit product feedback, browse or prioritize feature requests, manage a roadmap, plan work from customer demand, or publish a changelog. Public tools work without credentials; ask for project_slug when it is missing. Authenticated project administration requires VOTESHIP_API_KEY or a Bearer secret. Before creating admin feedback, use search_similar to check for duplicates. Confirm exact IDs and explicit user intent before destructive tools. Read voteship://service/agent-guide for setup and website installation guidance.
